written_before_outcomes: writing started 2026-10-20T14:45:00Z (date -u), before any candidate outcome of this campaign; no label read, no real-data computation, no label-reading loader called
implementation: nrm/rules.py (pure functions; load_rules() checks this file against the module constants); invented-data tests and known-law screen checks: python3 -m nrm.test_rules (writes SCREEN_CHECKS.json in this directory)
status_of_every_rule: development rule on previously and adaptively used MODEL_SELECT records; changes no original limit; the two-SE reserve is a development heuristic, not a cap or population guarantee; every uncertainty statement is asymptotic and model-based (normal approximation, conservative variance bounds), never a finite-sample or distribution-free guarantee

original_limits.utility_clauses: income and occupation x U0_S<v> and Ucal_S<v> x accuracy loss, NLL excess (nats), summed Brier excess x versions 0 and 1: 24 clauses (inclusive)
original_limits.guards: within-SEX occupation summed-Brier excess vs U0_S<v>, men (sex0) and women (sex1), versions 0 and 1: 4 guards (inclusive)
original_limits.recipient_definition: each single output's SEX-recovery AUC minus the comparator's (income view, occupation view) <= 0.010, per comparator, view and version (OHN1 original_limits.recipient; TSZ1 section 0)

versions.independence: procedure repeats sharing every training row and the MODEL_SELECT people; never independent replications

reserve.rule: ohn.rules.reserve imported unchanged (OHN1-rules-v1, SHA-256 e18f1c68...); k = 2; se_used = max(own SE, H_LJ floor SE x sqrt(5306 / households)); margin = cap - value >= 2 se_used (inclusive)
reserve.randomized_own_se: sqrt(se^2 + se_mc^2) before flooring (se = mean per-draw household-clustered SE, se_mc = SD over draws / sqrt(R)); the reserve without the MC term is reported beside it
reserve.applies_to: candidates, controls and references identically (whole release, 28 conditions over both versions)
reserve.qualified: RESERVE_MET on both versions (minimum whole-release ratio >= 2 on each version)

cells.decision_cells: registered cells only (every configuration has them); robustness cells give a separate ROBUSTNESS label and never change a decision or a ranking
cells.fraction_cells: learning-curve cells (name contains '@') never enter a screen

aggregate_screen.estimator: block b = (version, repetition); block mean m_b = mean of its reader-seed cells; aggregate x = mean of block means; per-version mean = mean of that version's block means

se_components.household: se_hh = sqrt(sum_c w_c s_c^2), w_c = cell weight in x (RMS of the paired household-bootstrap cell SEs): an upper bound of the SCORE-household sampling SE of x for ANY correlation between cells (shared households across versions, seeds and overlapping repetitions)
se_components.reader_split_version: se_rs = sqrt(sum_b (m_b - x)^2 / n_blocks): for the crossed 2-version x n-repetition design this has expectation >= the version, split, interaction and reader-seed part of Var(x) (equal for the version and split components when there are 2 levels of each, larger otherwise)
se_components.monte_carlo: se_mc = sqrt(sum_c w_c mc_c^2) for randomized releases (cell MC SE = SD over draws / sqrt(D)); reported separately
se_components.total: se_agg = max(sqrt(se_hh^2 + se_rs^2 + se_mc^2), se_floor_auc) unless the comparison is an exact alias

benefit_labels.ALIAS_ZERO: every cell value and SE exactly 0 (identical wire): never positive
benefit_labels.AGG_POSITIVE: x - z se_agg > 0 and both version means > 0
benefit_labels.INCOMPLETE: a registered cell, SE or finite value missing

target_labels.TARGET_AGG_RESOLVED: x - z se_agg > 0.020 and both version means > 0.020

aggregate_screen.recipient: per version v (the original allowance is per version): r_v = mean of v's block means, se_v from v's cells only; gate (original allowance at the aggregate point): r_v <= 0.010 for both versions; RECIPIENT_AGG_RESOLVED (r_v + z se_v <= 0.010 both), RECIPIENT_AGG_EDGE (point pass, not resolved), RECIPIENT_AGG_POINT_FAILED, RECIPIENT_AGG_RESOLVED_WORSE (some r_v - z se_v > 0.010), ALIAS_ZERO (passes)
aggregate_screen.old_every_cell_rule: kept beside as a diagnostic: tsz.rules.recipient_gate (every registered cell <= 0.010) and tsz.rules.stability_label (STABLE_POSITIVE) on the 8 registered cells; a disagreement is flagged EVERY_CELL_RULE_DIVERGES and disclosed; earlier campaigns are never relabelled
aggregate_screen.aliases: an exact alias (identical wire of the compared view) is one zero comparison; comparator views with identical wires form one alias group, reported once and counted once in every count; seed-deterministic duplicate cells (k cells of a block with bitwise equal values) count once in n_eff
aggregate_screen.sign_reversals: cells (distinct) whose sign differs from the aggregate's, block means and version means with the other sign, reported for every comparison

reader_stability.grid_validity: A-SC1 criterion applied prospectively: (i) recorded distinct integer reader seeds, none equal to MODEL_SEED_BASE + 300 or + 500 + 10 v + k (k = 0..9); (ii) no k0/k1 equality of a seed-dependent recipe on the minimum set (the selected candidate and its matched controls); (iii) every other equality explained (another seed-dependent recipe differs in the same wire, view, version, repetition; the same recipe differs on another view of the same wire; the view's distinct-input count recorded), where differs means a RECORDED check with equal_k0_k1 false; the four registered seeds S0k0, S0k1, S1k0, S1k1 must be recorded; claims need grid_valid recorded and true (missing: NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_VALIDITY_UNKNOWN; false: NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_INVALID for G2-G6, no tier); seed-invariant recipes that differ are flagged NONDETERMINISTIC_RECIPE (not fatal)

definitions.W: A1_PO_16 (100% of MODEL_FIT) occupation + H3 income (TSZ1 witness)
definitions.TT100: T_TREE (100%) occupation + H3 income (TSZ1 control's first stage)

references.eligibility_rule: original point eligibility only: all 24 clauses and 4 guards pass at the point on both versions from the published MODEL_SELECT values; reserve, recovery and any outcome of this campaign play no role; a re-evaluation by nrm.evaluate is reported beside and a disagreement is flagged REFERENCE_POINT_STATUS_DISAGREES (the published label governs)

diagnostic.PUB_IBSI: DIAGNOSTIC_POINT_INELIGIBLE (published seed-1 men's guard 0.0050142 > 0.005): descriptive only, never in the original benchmark
diagnostic.U0, Ucal: UTILITY_REFERENCE_ONLY (define the clauses; not recovery comparators)

references.frozen: this set and these labels never change after any outcome of this campaign

frontier.primary_cost: total NLL spending of the complete release: income NLL + occupation NLL (nats per person, MODEL_SELECT, draw-averaged), compared through paired per-person differences d = cost(candidate) - cost(control) with household-clustered SEs; across versions d = mean of the two version differences, SE = mean of the two SEs (versions share people: correlation bound); if only per-task SEs are given, SE(sum) <= se_income + se_occupation (flag COST_SE_BOUND)
frontier.bracket: Q* = the control-path point with the smallest pooled cost among those whose pooled point cost is >= the candidate's (d <= 0); no exact cost match is required
frontier.dominates: DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER iff a bracket Q* exists, the pair benefit vs Q* is AGG_POSITIVE (aggregate screen) and no secondary metric shows resolved extra spending vs Q* (d_m - z se_m > 0)
frontier.secondary_required: all 8 secondary metrics against Q* must be present and finite; otherwise INCOMPLETE (the secondary check is never skipped)
frontier.interpolation: linear interpolation of the control path's pair AUC at the candidate's cost between the bracketing points, with SE <= (1 - lambda) se_lo + lambda se_hi (the cost uncertainty of lambda is not propagated; the primary cost SEs are reported beside it); reported, never gating

claims.G1: TASK_FEASIBLE iff the complete release (actual emitted outputs; randomized: draw-averaged) passes all 24 clauses and 4 guards at the point; reserve reported beside, never part of G1
claims.G2: INCREMENTAL_REDUCTION_BEYOND_MATCHED_CONTROLS iff G1 and, against BOTH the family's equally trained task-only twin and its declared simplest alternative explanation, the pair benefit is AGG_POSITIVE and the recipient gate passes (both views, both versions); MET_WITHOUT_TASK_FEASIBILITY if the comparisons pass without G1; NO_MATCHED_CONTROLS if either control is missing
claims.G3: STABLE_FRONTIER_IMPROVEMENT iff G1 and the actual selected output's frontier label is DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER against the family's SEX-blind control path
claims.G4: SUPERIOR_TO_ALL_ELIGIBLE_REFERENCES iff G1 and, against every point-eligible original-benchmark reference, AGG_POSITIVE pair benefit and the recipient gate (both views, both versions); the old every-cell profile is reported beside (OLD_RULE_PROFILE)
claims.G5: MATERIAL_0020_RESOLVED iff G1, TARGET_AGG_RESOLVED against NEURAL_RAW and against H_LJ, and the recipient gate against both; TARGET_RESOLVED_RECIPIENT_GATE_FAILED (target resolved against both, a recipient gate fails); MATERIAL_0020_POINT_ONLY (aggregate mean > 0.020 against both, not resolved); POSITIVE_BELOW_MATERIAL_TARGET (AGG_POSITIVE against both, target not met); NOT_MET; without G1 any level above NOT_MET becomes MET_WITHOUT_TASK_FEASIBILITY (level kept); a separate claim, never nested in or implied by G4 (G4 is reported beside it)
claims.G6: in order: fewer than two distinct outputs changed -> NOT_APPLICABLE_ONE_OUTPUT_CHANGED (names the output); both changed but not declared jointly designed (or no joint record) -> NOT_APPLICABLE_NOT_JOINT; separate design or a sequential order missing -> NOT_ASSESSED_MISSING_CONTROLS; JOINT_CONTRIBUTION_SUPPORTED iff against the matched separate design and both sequential orders the pair benefit is AGG_POSITIVE, the recipient gate passes and the primary cost is not resolved higher; else NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.G7: novelty: copied verbatim from a separate prior-art review (NOT_CLAIMED by default); never inferred from any performance label
claims.useful_component: USEFUL_COMPONENT_NOT_COMPETITIVE iff G2 holds and G4 does not; always shown
claims.protection_without_feasibility: any protection label without G1 is MET_WITHOUT_TASK_FEASIBILITY and never claimable

selection.universe: the complete ledger: every configuration of every family and every challenger control saved through nrm.release.save and evaluated in both versions; control-labelled configurations compete on equal terms and are never excluded after results
selection.score: minimum over the point-eligible original-benchmark references of the registered-cell aggregate pair benefit x (higher is better)
tie_breaks: reserve-qualified on both versions first (implied by the leximin vector when both versions are evaluated; kept explicit)
leximin whole-release reserve ratio vector (larger minimum first)
fewer fitted components (a number, or a per-version record summed over both versions; 0 is 0; missing is infinite)
selection.aliases: a configuration whose wires equal a reference's (both tasks, both versions; the wires of all 9 references are a REQUIRED input) or whose pair comparison against a reference is ALIAS_ZERO is ALIAS_OF_<REFERENCE>; equal to an earlier configuration: ALIAS_OF_<earlier config_id>; neither is selectable
selection.actual_outputs: the wire hashes recorded with the utility evaluation and with the grid must be equal per version and task (every draw for randomized releases); otherwise NOT_SELECTABLE_OUTPUT_MISMATCH; no nearby strength, seed or draw is substituted
selection.incomplete: NOT_SELECTABLE_INCOMPLETE_REFERENCE_GRID when a grid entry against one of the 9 references is missing or incomplete (the score needs all 9)
selection.none: NO_DEVELOPMENT_CANDIDATE when no configuration reaches T2

randomized.utility: each metric on each emitted draw (vector and its own argmax), averaged over R predeclared one-draw-per-person repetitions; household SE = mean per-draw SE; MC SE = SD over draws / sqrt(R), reported separately; every draw's own point status reported (WORST_DRAW diagnostic)
randomized.grid: cell value = mean over the cell's evaluated draws; household SE = RMS of the draws' paired bootstrap SEs (bound for shared households); MC SE = SD over draws / sqrt(D) (D >= 2; D = 1 gives MC_SE_NOT_ESTIMABLE)
randomized.decision: MC SE enters the aggregate SE as its own component and the reserve's own SE in quadrature; the three components are always reported separately
